text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see? Narita Brian's 
declaration!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I saw it! That's why I came to watch since 
the Hanshin Daishoten! I mean—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Unless she keeps winning from this race 
on, Narita Brian's declaration means 
nothing."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her remarks at the award ceremony the 
other day were heavily covered by the 
media and quickly became known to the 
public.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Whether such a thing exists or not doesn't 
matter.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No matter who is running, no matter what 
kind of race it is, all I need to do... is 
blow them completely away!!
